Jeu de tir de bulles en pixel art : vise: Pixel art bubble shooter: aim with the mouse, keyboard or gamepad (the dotted line shows the bounces), shoot, and group at least three bubbles of the same colour to pop them into drops; everything no longer held by the ceiling falls, and several clusters at once make a combo. Bomb, rainbow bubble and stones that never break; the ceiling comes down every 7 shots, X swaps the bubble with the next one, each cleared board brings a new one with one more colour. Full screen, and the aquarium fits the size of the window.
Le pointillé montre la trajectoire, rebo: The dotted line shows the trajectory, including bounces on the edges.
